catalog_metadata.title: NIST FIPS 140-3 Approved Security Functions, Parameters & TLS Policy Catalog
normative_sources: NIST SP 800-140D (CMVP Approved Sensitive Security Parameter Generation and Establishment Methods)
NIST SP 800-131A Rev. 2 (Transitioning the Use of Cryptographic Algorithms and Key Lengths)
NIST FIPS 180-4 (Secure Hash Standard) & FIPS 202 (SHA-3 Standard)
NIST SP 800-38A / SP 800-38D (Block Cipher Modes of Operation & GCM)
NIST SP 800-90A Rev. 1 (Recommendation for Random Number Generation Using Deterministic Random Bit Generators)
NIST SP 800-52 Rev. 2 (Guidelines for the Selection, Configuration, and Use of TLS Implementations)
NIST SP 800-56A Rev. 3 & SP 800-56B Rev. 2 (Key-Establishment Schemes)
NIST SP 800-132 (Recommendation for Password-Based Key Derivation)

md2.title: Disallowed hash algorithm: MD2
md2.message: MD2 is cryptographically broken and disallowed for all federal cryptographic protection.
md2.remediation: Replace MD2 with SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, or SHA-3 from a CMVP-validated cryptographic module.

md4.title: Disallowed hash algorithm: MD4
md4.message: MD4 is cryptographically broken and disallowed for all federal cryptographic protection.
md4.remediation: Replace MD4 with SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, or SHA-3 from a CMVP-validated cryptographic module.

md5.title: Non-approved hash algorithm: MD5
md5.message: MD5 is disallowed as a cryptographic hash function under FIPS 180-4 and NIST SP 800-140C.
md5.remediation: Use SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, or SHA-3 from a validated module; if strictly non-security (e.g., ETag/cache key), isolate and pass usedforsecurity=False where supported.

sha1.title: Disallowed hash algorithm for digital signatures / general security hashing: SHA-1
sha1.message: SHA-1 is disallowed for digital signature generation and collision-resistant security functions (note: HMAC-SHA-1 remains approved with key length >= 112 bits).
sha1.remediation: Migrate digital signatures and integrity hashing to SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, or SHA-3-256+.

ripemd160.title: Non-approved hash algorithm: RIPEMD-160
ripemd160.message: RIPEMD-160 is not an approved hash function in FIPS 180-4, FIPS 202, or NIST SP 800-140C.
ripemd160.remediation: Replace RIPEMD-160 with SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, or SHA-3-256.

whirlpool.title: Non-approved hash algorithm: Whirlpool
whirlpool.message: Whirlpool is not an approved hash function under NIST SP 800-140C.
whirlpool.remediation: Replace Whirlpool with SHA-512 or SHA-3-512.

blake2b.title: Non-approved hash algorithm: BLAKE2b
blake2b.message: BLAKE2b is not listed in NIST SP 800-140C approved hash functions.
blake2b.remediation: Use SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-3, or SHAKE256 from a CMVP-validated module for FIPS-scoped security functions.

blake2s.title: Non-approved hash algorithm: BLAKE2s
blake2s.message: BLAKE2s is not listed in NIST SP 800-140C approved hash functions.
blake2s.remediation: Use SHA-256 or SHA-3-256 from a CMVP-validated module for FIPS-scoped security functions.

hmac-md5.title: Non-approved MAC algorithm: HMAC-MD5
hmac-md5.message: HMAC-MD5 uses unapproved MD5 and is disallowed under FIPS 198-1 and NIST SP 800-140C.
hmac-md5.remediation: Migrate to HMAC-SHA-256, HMAC-SHA-384, HMAC-SHA-512, or KMAC256.

des.title: Disallowed symmetric cipher: DES
des.message: 56-bit DES is withdrawn and disallowed under NIST SP 800-131A Rev. 2.
des.remediation: Migrate to AES-128 or AES-256 in an approved authenticated mode (e.g., AES-256-GCM).

3des.title: Disallowed symmetric cipher: 3DES / Triple-DES (TDEA)
3des.message: Three-key TDEA (3DES) encryption is disallowed after 2023-12-31 per NIST SP 800-131A Rev. 2.
3des.remediation: Migrate all symmetric encryption to AES (128, 192, or 256-bit) in GCM, CCM, or CBC+HMAC mode.

rc2.title: Non-approved symmetric cipher: RC2
rc2.message: RC2 is not an approved symmetric algorithm under NIST SP 800-140C.
rc2.remediation: Replace RC2 with AES-256-GCM from a CMVP-validated module.

rc4.title: Non-approved stream cipher: RC4 / ARCFOUR
rc4.message: RC4 has severe statistical biases, is prohibited in TLS (RFC 7465 / SP 800-52 Rev. 2), and is not FIPS-approved.
rc4.remediation: Replace RC4 with AES-GCM or AES-CTR+HMAC.

blowfish.title: Non-approved symmetric cipher: Blowfish
blowfish.message: Blowfish uses a 64-bit block size (vulnerable to birthday attacks) and is not a FIPS-approved algorithm.

cast5.title: Non-approved symmetric cipher: CAST5
cast5.message: CAST5 (CAST-128) is not an approved symmetric cipher under NIST SP 800-140C.

idea.title: Non-approved symmetric cipher: IDEA
idea.message: IDEA is not an approved symmetric cipher under NIST SP 800-140C.

chacha20.title: Non-FIPS stream cipher: ChaCha20 / ChaCha20-Poly1305
chacha20.message: ChaCha20 and ChaCha20-Poly1305 are modern ciphers, but are not NIST-approved algorithms under FIPS 140-3 / NIST SP 800-140C.
chacha20.remediation: For FIPS 140-3 / SC-13 workloads, use AES-128-GCM or AES-256-GCM (FIPS 197 + SP 800-38D).

salsa20.title: Non-FIPS stream cipher: Salsa20 / XSalsa20
salsa20.message: Salsa20 / XSalsa20 is not an approved algorithm under NIST SP 800-140C.
salsa20.remediation: Use AES-256-GCM from a CMVP-validated module.

ECB.title: Insecure block cipher mode: AES-ECB
ECB.message: Electronic Codebook (ECB) mode leaks plaintext block patterns and lacks semantic security for multi-block data.
ECB.remediation: Replace ECB mode with authenticated AES-GCM (SP 800-38D) or AES-CBC with random IV and HMAC.

rsa_min_bits.title: Insufficient RSA modulus size (< 2048 bits)
rsa_min_bits.message: RSA key lengths below 2048 bits provide less than 112 bits of security strength and are disallowed.
rsa_min_bits.remediation: Generate RSA keys with modulus >= 2048 bits (3072 or 4096 bits recommended).

dh_min_bits.title: Insufficient Diffie-Hellman / FFC group size (< 2048 bits)
dh_min_bits.message: Finite-field Diffie-Hellman groups smaller than 2048 bits are disallowed under SP 800-56A Rev. 3 and SP 800-131A Rev. 2.
dh_min_bits.remediation: Use named safe-prime FFDHE groups >= 2048 bits (RFC 7919) or ECDHE with P-256 / P-384.

dsa_disallowed.title: Deprecated signature algorithm: Finite-Field DSA
dsa_disallowed.message: Finite-field DSA was removed for new digital signature generation in FIPS 186-5 (prior signatures may only be verified).
dsa_disallowed.remediation: Migrate digital signature generation to ECDSA (P-256/P-384), EdDSA (Ed25519/Ed448), or RSA-PSS (>= 2048 bits).

disallowed_rule.title: Non-approved elliptic curve parameter
disallowed_rule.message: Curve is outside the NIST-approved curves in FIPS 186-5 / SP 800-56A Rev. 3 (P-256, P-384, P-521, Ed25519, Ed448).
disallowed_rule.remediation: Use NIST P-256 (secp256r1), P-384 (secp384r1), P-521 (secp521r1), or Ed25519/Ed448 inside a validated module.

static_iv_or_nonce.title: Hardcoded or static initialization vector (IV) / GCM nonce
static_iv_or_nonce.message: Using a constant or hardcoded IV/nonce breaks semantic security and catastrophically compromises AES-GCM / CTR confidentiality and authenticity.
static_iv_or_nonce.remediation: Generate a fresh unique IV/nonce per encryption operation using an approved SP 800-90A Rev. 1 DRBG.

pbkdf2_min_iterations.title: Weak PBKDF2 key derivation parameters
pbkdf2_min_iterations.message: PBKDF2 configured with low iteration count (< 10,000) or short/static salt (< 128 bits).
pbkdf2_min_iterations.remediation: Configure PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA-256/512 with >= 100,000 iterations (minimum 10,000 per legacy SP 800-132 floor) and a >= 16-byte CSPRNG salt.

non_approved_rng.title: Non-cryptographic PRNG used in security context
non_approved_rng.message: Predictable non-cryptographic PRNG invoked to generate keys, tokens, nonces, salts, or credentials instead of an SP 800-90A Rev. 1 DRBG.
non_approved_rng.remediation: Use a CSPRNG backed by an approved SP 800-90A Rev. 1 DRBG (e.g., secrets/os.urandom, crypto/rand, SecureRandom, crypto.randomBytes, RandomNumberGenerator).

deprecated_protocol.title: Deprecated SSL/TLS protocol version (< TLS 1.2)
deprecated_protocol.message: SSLv2, SSLv3, TLS 1.0, and TLS 1.1 are disallowed for federal information systems under NIST SP 800-52 Rev. 2.
deprecated_protocol.remediation: Enforce TLS 1.2 (with FIPS-approved cipher suites) or TLS 1.3 exclusively.

cert_verification_disabled.title: TLS X.509 certificate verification disabled
cert_verification_disabled.message: Disabling TLS certificate or hostname verification exposes encrypted channels to active man-in-the-middle interception.
cert_verification_disabled.remediation: Enable strict X.509 certificate chain and hostname verification against a trusted CA bundle.

non_approved_cipher_suite.title: Non-approved TLS cipher suite configured
non_approved_cipher_suite.message: TLS configuration permits weak, anonymous, export, RC4, 3DES, MD5, or non-FIPS cipher suites.
non_approved_cipher_suite.remediation: Restrict TLS 1.2/1.3 cipher suites to NIST SP 800-52 Rev. 2 §3.3.1 approved ECDHE/AES-GCM or AES-CCM suites.
